visual.general_description: Four endoscopic photographs of the esophageal lumen arranged in a 2 by 2 grid labeled (A) to (D).
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 2 grid of octagonal endoscopic frames on a black background labeled (A) upper left, (B) upper right, (C) lower left and (D) lower right. (A) shows reddish mucosa with white to pale streaks and flecks around a dark central lumen; (B) and (C) show pink mucosa with fine longitudinal lines converging on a small dark central lumen; (D) shows orange-red mucosa around a large dark lumen with bright glare at the lower edge. No numeric values, scale bars or arrows are visible.

panels.general_description: Endoscopic view of a reddish mucosal lumen with white to pale streaks and patches scattered over the surface and a dark central opening.
panels.detailed_description: Octagonal black-bordered endoscopic frame. The mucosa is dark reddish-brown with numerous irregular white to pale streaks and flecks, many oriented radially toward a dark central lumen; folds converge on the center. Panel letter (A) is printed at the upper left on a white background. No scale, arrow or measurement is visible.
